info.name: NationBuilder V2 Async Processes Event Ticket Levels API
List all event ticket levels in a nation

params.name: include
params.description:
Comma-delimited list of sideloaded resources to include as part of the event ticket level index response.
See guidance [here](https://support.nationbuilder.com/en/articles/9899245-api-v2-walkthrough#h_2d5333adab) about
sideloading large numbers of resources and pagination.

params.name: fields[event_ticket_levels]
params.description: Comma-delimited list of event ticket level attributes to only return in the response

params.name: page[size]
params.description: Number of results to display per page (default: 20, max: 100, min: 1)

items.docs: Lists all event ticket levels in the nation. To request ticket levels for a specific event, filter on event_id using query filtering, `filter[event_id]=123`. Both the Event and Event RSVPs associated with a ticket level can be sideloaded.

params.name: include
params.description:
Comma-delimited list of sideloaded resources to include as part of the event ticket level index response.
See guidance [here](https://support.nationbuilder.com/en/articles/9899245-api-v2-walkthrough#h_2d5333adab) about
sideloading large numbers of resources and pagination.

params.name: fields[event_ticket_levels]
params.description: Comma-delimited list of event ticket level attributes to only return in the response

items.docs: Creates an event ticket level. Ticket levels must be associated with an event, have a name, a number indicating how many tickets are included in a single purchase, a limit indicating the max number of tickets that can be sold, and an amount in cents indicating the cost of purchasing tickets at this ticket level.
